chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Qasim, the mawla of Abi Ayyub, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Regarding maghrib: when the disc disappears, the time of the two prayers begins until midnight, except that this one is before this one. And when the sun passes the zenith, then the time of the two prayers has entered, except that this one is before this one.

key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declined past the zenith
key_terms.وَقْتُ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ: the shared time of the two prayers

ai.seo_question: When do the times for maghrib and 'isha', and zuhr and 'asr, begin and end according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal times for two paired salat (prayer): maghrib and 'isha' from sunset until midnight, and zuhr and 'asr from the sun’s decline past zenith. In both cases, the time covers both prayers together, while preserving the required order that one is performed before the other.
